dedupe_keys.name: agencia portuguesa do ambiente drinking water datasets

description: Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. Coverage: Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. The listing groups 21 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Zonas designadas para a proteção de captação de água destinada ao cons; Perímetros de proteção imediata captação superficial; Perímetros de proteção especial captação subterrânea; Perímetros de proteção alargada captação subterrânea. Formats seen: ZIP, WFS, PDF, WMS, XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
